description: This is an HTML source file that defines the structure, style, and client-side scripting for a database viewing web interface. It includes layout components like sidebar for database selection, main content area for table data display, and JavaScript functions for fetching and rendering database information dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetch and display list of databases from the server.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refresh the database list by re-fetching from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggle display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetch and display list of tables within the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetch and display data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Render the data into an HTML table format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Render individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggle the display of full content in a cell.
